note: 2026-10-29 source-side no-image scenarios. Definitions are not executed model runs or visual-quality evidence. Four garment cases plus coverage/full-body perturbations and lineage/reference/authorization boundaries; runtime regressions separately verify deterministic transmission. 2026-11-03 adds first-batch aesthetic planning scenarios; these remain not-run model evaluations.

evals.prompt: 清晰印花上衣正面和前侧图，胸前图案与完整衣长是商品展示重点；已有AI人物和风格，只准备默认套图，不生图。
